newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt supporter attacks attitude of hardleft.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt supporter attacks attitude of hardleft.

text.p: A leading member of Italy's centre-left coalition said on Monday that the government was entering a difficult period and criticised the position of the hard-left Communist Refoundation party.

Fabio Mussi, parliamentary party leader of the Democratic Party of the Left (PDS) which is the government's main political backer, said that relations between the members of the coalition were "not sailing in calm waters".
"We are facing the usual problems, always on the knife edge, with Refoundation threatening to withdraw support," he told reporters at a conference on new immigration proposals.
Mussi said the situation was "risky and Refoundation's attitude ever more untenable."

Fausto Bertinotti, the leader of Refoundation which controls the balance of power in Italy's lower house of parliament, said earlier on Monday he did not want to pull the rug from under the coalition but repeated objections to the planned mini-budget.
"If (the government) cuts social spending then we will stop supporting them," Bertinotti told a news conference.

Prime Minister Romano Prodi has said he will shortly unveil a mini-budget with up to 14.5 trillion lire of deficit-cutting measures to prepare the economy for the launch of the single European currency. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
